title: Coherator detection on arbitrary derived morphisms
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, with derived category and quasi-coherent full subcategory [def-pc-derived-category]. Let DQ be a right adjoint to the inclusion. If s:E→E′ is a morphism of the ambient derived category whose image DQ(s) is an isomorphism, then RΓ(Y,s) [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose K-injective representatives I,J and representing isomorphisms. Transport s to Q(I)→Q(J). The bijective Qh-map on morphisms into J [lem-sc-kinjective-quasi-iso-comparison] and fullness of the homotopy quotient give a chain map r whose localization equals that transported morphism. Isomorphism after DQ is preserved under these conjugations. Apply dqCoherator_detects_globalSections [lem-pc-dq-coherator-adjunction] to r. Its termwise global-sections map is a quasi-isomorphism, so its localization is an isomorphism. Naturality of mapHomotopyCategoryFactors and quotientCompQhIso transports this to the homotopy model. Naturality of the invertible right-derived units on I and J then shows RΓ(Q(r)) is invertible. Finally transport back to s along the representing isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0B6I, final paragraph, K-injective transport implemented by R3

theorem dqCoherator_isIso_derivedGlobalSections (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    (DQ : schemeDerivedCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⊣ DQ)
    {E E' : schemeDerivedCategory Y} (s : E ⟶ E') [IsIso (DQ.map s)] :
    IsIso ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).map s)
